about:
Bell House Medical, also known as Master Grab Bar, has operated from Lewes, Delaware since 1986. The company serves customers across Delaware and Maryland from its location on Coastal Highway, providing home safety and medical equipment services to the region.

The business provides installation services for stairlifts, grab bars, railings, vertical platform lifts, vehicle scooter lifts, porch lifts, and wheelchair ramps. It also performs home modifications such as doorway widening and tub-to-shower conversions. A retail store on site sells and rents mobility equipment including scooters, lift chairs, rollators, canes, orthopedic supports, ortho boots, and compression stockings, supporting both purchase and short-term rental needs.

The company focuses on the aging-in-place market, helping older adults remain at home safely. Its customer base spans residential clients throughout Delaware and Maryland seeking home safety and medical equipment solutions. The firm’s offerings address mobility challenges and accessibility requirements for private homes.

old_description: In operation since 1981 Bergeys Parts Warehouse has grown to meet our customers’ needs--we stock over three million dollars’ worth of OEM parts for our valued customers.  In addition to our OEM parts we also offer aftermarket parts from
about:
Bergey's Wholesale Parts operates from Colmar, Pennsylvania, where it was founded in 1981. The company began as a parts warehouse serving the greater Philadelphia and Allentown areas.

The business distributes original equipment (OE) and aftermarket parts for Ford, Lincoln, GM (Chevrolet, Buick, GMC, Cadillac), and Chrysler (Jeep, Dodge, Ram, MOPAR) vehicles. It maintains an inventory valued at over $3 million, including Magneti Marelli aftermarket lines. The Colmar facility serves walk-in customers and wholesale accounts, with a team of ten sales specialists. Local delivery covers 13-plus counties across Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Delaware, while national orders ship via UPS or FedEx. An online catalog allows VIN-based parts lookup for both retail and wholesale buyers.

Customers include independent repair shops, collision centers, and fleet operators throughout the Mid-Atlantic region. Wholesale accounts in the 13-county delivery area receive regular route service, while retail buyers can purchase at the counter or online. The company's catalogs cover mechanical repair parts as well as collision body components.

Bergey's Wholesale Parts was built to meet customer demand for a deep, readily available stock of OE parts, supplemented by aftermarket alternatives. The combination of a large local inventory, dedicated delivery routes, and experienced sales staff is intended to keep vehicles on the road with minimal downtime.

about:
Bernman Mold & Engineering Inc. has operated as a family-owned business in Ontario, California since 1994. The company traces its roots to Manuel J. Solorio Sr., who founded a precision mold manufacturing shop in Upland, California. After more than two decades at that location, the operation moved to a 7,000-square-foot facility in Ontario, where Solorio's son, Manuel A. Solorio Jr., now serves as owner.

The shop produces custom steel molds and provides a range of mold-related services including molding, advanced polishing, new tooling, laser welding, CNC machining, and reverse engineering. A team of about ten works with equipment such as Haas and Okuma machining centers, Mitsubishi EDM machines, a Mitutoyo CMM, and a laser welder. The company emphasizes its combined 60-plus years of mold-making experience.

Bernman serves customers in medical, aerospace, military, irrigation, agriculture, cosmetic, electronics and technology, and automotive sectors. The company states it can refurbish, repair, design, and inject molds for these industries.

The business highlights its "100% Made in America" production and a problem-solving approach that aims to turn product ideas into reality. Its family ownership and deep mold-making heritage are presented as key differentiators.

name: Biomerics
old_description: We manufacture a variety of plastic medical device parts, from large enclosures to microcomponents. Our engineering specialists can help you select the right polymer material and manufacturing method for your medical component or device.
about:
Biomerics, headquartered in Brooklyn Park, Minnesota, traces its roots to 1994 when it was founded as Utah Plastics Group with three employees and a single customer. The privately owned company has grown from one location to a vertically integrated contract manufacturer with 12 facilities globally, including campuses in Costa Rica and the Dominican Republic.

The company provides end-to-end contract manufacturing for interventional medical devices, offering design services, material selection, engineered components, and finished device assembly. Its core processes include micromachining and Swiss turning, precision extrusion, injection molding, and micro metals processing. With 12 facilities strategically located in medical device hubs, Biomerics operates a vertically integrated ecosystem from pellet to finished device.

Biomerics serves the interventional medical device market, working with global original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) in areas such as medical robotics, cardiovascular, and endoscopy. The company cites partnerships to design, develop, and manufacture single-use endoscopes and other minimally invasive devices.

The company emphasizes its engineering-first approach and vertically integrated model, built through strategic investments and acquisitions to combine materials and process technologies under one roof. Its leadership team, composed largely of engineers, aims to provide a flexible, customer-focused partnership that scales from prototype to commercialization.

name: Biro Manufacturing Co
old_description: established in 1921, is an Ohio, USA corporation.  BIRO designs, manufactures, and markets, durable and reliable power operated, stainless steel, food and meat processing machinery.  BIRO is committed to satisfy specific needs of all segments of the food, meat, and seafood industry: food retail stores, food service, and food processing.
about:
Biro Manufacturing Co. is based in Lakeside Marblehead, Ohio, and was founded in 1921 by Carl G. Biro Sr., a Hungarian immigrant who had worked as a blacksmith’s son and later ran his own meat market. After recognizing the need for a more practical meat-cutting machine, he sold his market, leased an old church building, and began producing the first Biro power meat, fish, and bone cutter.

The company designs, manufactures, and markets a line of power-operated, stainless-steel food and meat processing equipment. Its product range includes power saws, tenderizers and knitters, cubers, strip cutters, horizontal high-speed slicers, manual-feed grinders, auto-feed mixer/grinders, and marinating vacuum tumblers. All machines are built at the company’s Ohio headquarters facility.

Biro serves the food retail, food service, and food processing sectors, with a focus on the meat and seafood industries. Its equipment is used in grocery stores, restaurants, and processing plants across the United States and internationally.

Biro emphasizes engineering that prioritizes safety and sanitation, and it offers customization to meet specific customer requirements. The company says its machines are designed for longer service life with less downtime, supported by reasonably priced parts and a global network of independently owned, factory-trained distributors.

name: Bismarck Canvas Co
old_description: Bismarck Canvas, Inc. has been manufacturing high-quality, American-made tarp systems and accessories since 1994. Our Pro-Lok® Roll Tarps, Dura-Trap® Electric Hopper Openers, and EXT® Electric Tarp Conversions are built in the USA for long-lasting performance. Based in North Dakota, we proudly deliver durable, innovative tarp solutions with fast nationwide shipping and reliable customer service.
about:
Bismarck Canvas, Inc. has operated from Menoken, North Dakota, since its founding in 1994. The company sits along Interstate 94 in the central part of the state, where it designs and builds tarp systems and related accessories for agricultural and transportation markets. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The product line centers on roll tarp systems for grain trailers, including the Pro-Lok® manual and electric roll tarps, the Dura-Trap® electric hopper door openers, and the EXT® electric tarp conversion kits that retrofit manual systems. The company also produces the Pro-Shield™ windshield protection pads, drill covers for seeding equipment, and the Fas-Top Sport tonneau covers for pickup trucks. All items are sewn, heat-welded, and reinforced with webbing using American-made fabric at a single facility that handles design, manufacturing, and assembly under one roof.

Primary customers include grain farmers, custom harvesters, and trucking operations that need durable tarping solutions for bulk commodity transport. The tonneau covers serve pickup owners, while windshield pads and drill covers address equipment protection for agricultural and construction machinery. The company ships throughout the United States and Canada.

Bismarck Canvas emphasizes its domestic supply chain and rapid fulfillment, citing a two- to three-day turnaround on orders. The decision to keep all production in-house is presented as a way to control quality, fit, and craftsmanship while maintaining affordable pricing for premium-grade covers.

name: Black Wolf Design
old_description: Founded by Terry Sweeney, whose passion for woodworking was inspired by his grandfather—a master craftsman—Black Wolf Design has spent over 30 years helping elite interior designers bring one-of-a-kind spaces to life with heirloom-quality custom furniture.
about:
Black Wolf Design was founded in 1996 by Terry Sweeney in Omro, Wisconsin. Sweeney's passion for woodworking was inspired by his grandfather, a master craftsman, and the company began as a small shop dedicated to creating heirloom-quality custom furniture for elite interior designers.

The company produces custom wood furniture including dining tables, console tables, end tables, coffee tables, entertainment units, seating, storage pieces, and beds. It also offers premade solutions that are fully customizable. Expert artisans handcraft each piece using fine materials and techniques, and the firm provides design-as-a-service for fully branded environments. The process moves from client vision—CAD drawings, sketches, or inspiration images—through precision craftsmanship to white-glove delivery and installation.

Black Wolf Design serves the high-end interior design trade, supplying luxury residential, commercial, and hospitality projects. Its clients include firms such as Tom Stringer Design Partners, Craig & Company, and institutions like The Paine Art Center & Gardens. The company also furnishes bespoke pieces for museums, offices, bars, and hospitality suites, requiring plan drawings for kitchens and casework.

The firm emphasizes seamless customization, reliable production timelines, and flawless execution. It differentiates itself with a problem-solving team, transparent communication from quote to delivery, and a designer-centric approach that aims to make custom furniture simple for specifiers. The founding vision was to bring designers' visions to life with precision craftsmanship and white-glove service.

about:
Blackshirt Oilfield Services is a family-owned and operated business based in Arnegard, North Dakota, founded in 2014. The company began with a single truck serving the Bakken region and has grown steadily through a commitment to customer satisfaction.

Today the company operates a fleet of over 40 trucks, providing a comprehensive range of oilfield services including production hauling, flowback hauling, freshwater hauling, vacuum truck service, winch truck, hot shot, equipment and trailer rentals, side dump, wellsite grading, frac sand hauling, frac tank rentals, towing and recovery, and over-the-road transport.

Blackshirt serves oil and gas operators in the Bakken region of North Dakota, supporting wellsite operations with hauling, rental, and recovery services for production, flowback, and freshwater needs.

The company emphasizes its extensive oilfield history, commitment to safety, and a focus on friendly, timely service as key differentiators, with drivers ready to serve customers in a safe and timely manner.

old_description: Since 2008, Blue Creek Iron Works has been a trusted name in fabrication works in Alabama, delivering precision, quality, and reliability in every project. Based in Dadeville, Alabama, we provide complete steel fabrication solutions—from design and engineering to fabrication and installation—tailored to meet diverse needs, budgets, and specifications.
about:
Blue Creek Iron Works was founded in 2008 in Dadeville, Alabama, by Ronald and Nikki, who operate the company as a family-owned metal fabrication shop. The business began with a focus on delivering precision steel fabrication for local residential and commercial projects.

The company provides end-to-end steel fabrication services, including design, engineering, fabrication, and installation. Its 15-person team works with carbon steel and stainless steel, offering structural steel fabrication, plasma cutting, media blasting, and powder coating. The shop handles custom handrails, stairs, railings, and miscellaneous metal fabrications for projects ranging from patio furniture to industrial structures.

Blue Creek serves three primary markets: residential, commercial, and industrial. Residential clients have included homeowners on Lake Martin seeking updated interior and exterior railings, while commercial and industrial customers rely on the firm for egress stairs, showcase stairs, and structural steel assemblies. The company notes a portfolio of projects across North America valued up to $15 million.

The founders emphasize craftsmanship and attention to detail, aiming for 100 percent customer satisfaction. They position the firm as both an owner's representative and general contractor, managing projects from concept through installation.
